decisions.decision: Embed the model as a module in the camera application
decisions.context: Cameras need to inspect images without network access. A model module keeps inference in the application on each device.

alternatives.label: Model as module in modular monolith

chosen.label: Model as module in modular monolith

decisions.rationale: A local module supports inference when cameras have no network access and keeps the deployment model manageable for a small team.
consequences: Package the model with the camera application.

decisions.decision: Serve predictions through a local API
decisions.context: The inspection application needs timely predictions while cameras may be disconnected. A local service provides real-time predictions without relying on a remote endpoint.
decisions.rationale: Local serving matches on-device inspection and avoids requiring network access for predictions.
consequences: Run and monitor a prediction endpoint on each device.

decisions.decision: Automate model delivery with a CI/CD pipeline
decisions.context: A retrained model must reach production devices every week. Automating delivery reduces repeated manual work for the small team.
decisions.rationale: A repeatable pipeline suits the weekly release cadence and can reduce the effort of delivering updates across devices.
consequences: Define checks before deployment to devices.

decisions.decision: Keep rollback to the previous model version
decisions.context: Weekly model updates change the software running on production cameras. Retaining a known prior version gives the team a recovery path if an update performs poorly.
decisions.rationale: Rollback supports recovery from a problematic weekly update; the model catalog must preserve the previous release for redeployment.
consequences: Keep the prior model artifact available.
Test rollback on the device fleet.

decisions.decision: Version training data in a data version repository
decisions.context: Newly labelled images feed weekly retraining. Versioning the data helps connect a released model to the training inputs used to build it.
decisions.rationale: Versioned training inputs make weekly model releases easier to trace and reproduce, which supports safe delivery and rollback.
consequences: Store references to data versions with each model release.
Budget for data storage and repository upkeep.

decisions.decision: Retrain on a weekly schedule using batch learning
decisions.context: The brief specifies weekly retraining from newly labelled images. Batch learning and a scheduled trigger fit that cadence without requiring incremental training infrastructure.
decisions.rationale: The brief calls for weekly retraining, so batch learning is a direct fit. Schedule the pipeline weekly to use the newest labelled data available.
consequences: New labels wait for the next scheduled run.
